title: Distance Between Bus Stops
summary: A bus operates on a circular route with n stops numbered sequentially.
statement: A bus operates on a circular route with n stops numbered sequentially. The distance between each pair of adjacent stops is given. The bus can travel in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions. Determine the minimum distance between a specified starting stop and a destination stop.
constraints: distance[i] connects stop i to (i+1) mod n.
hints: Normalize endpoints so start is not after destination.
Sum the direct slice between them in increasing index order.
The opposite route costs total route length minus that slice.
The two arcs are the only possible simple routes, so their minimum is optimal.
editorial: The two arcs are the only possible simple routes, so their minimum is optimal.

tests.explanation: The direct clockwise edge has length one.
Counterclockwise uses the final edge of length four instead of clockwise length six.
